questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Material choice balances several requirements over an object's life.
options: Material choice balances several requirements over an object's life.
The cheapest initial material always has the lowest lifetime cost.
A strong material must always be easy to bend.
Appearance alone reveals how a material will perform outdoors.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Material choice balances several requirements over an object's life.

source.en: An environmental claim based on one attractive property can be misleading when the rest of the product's life is ignored.
source.tr: Ürünün ömrünün geri kalanı göz ardı edildiğinde çekici tek bir özelliğe dayanan çevresel iddia yanıltıcı olabilir.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: The cheapest initial material always has the lowest lifetime cost.
options: The cheapest initial material always has the lowest lifetime cost.
A student compares a metal cup with a paper cup and notices that they feel different.
A design team tests several packages to find one that protects a fragile object during transport.
An environmental claim based on one attractive property can be misleading when the rest of the product's life is ignored.

questions.prompt:
What does “without” express in this sentence?
A bicycle frame must support loads without becoming unnecessarily heavy.
options: olmadan; bulunmayan koşulu belirtir
yalnızca kişinin adını belirtir
fiilin geçmişte tamamlandığını tek başına gösterir
soru sormak için kullanılır
questions.explanation: Bu cümlede “without”: olmadan; bulunmayan koşulu belirtir. Bisiklet gövdesi gereksiz yere ağırlaşmadan yükleri taşımalıdır.
